cwg_reliefweb.last_update_basis: Page lists no documents, events or updated stamp.
cwg_reliefweb.dashboard_name: Mozambique: 2025 Humanitarian Response, Cash Assistance Overview (OCHA monthly infographic)
cwg_reliefweb.contacts_basis: Page says focal-point contact details will be shared but names no organisations.
cwg_reliefweb.note: National group active since 2017 with a Beira sub-group, supported by the Southern Africa regional technical CWG; chairs and meeting dates not published on the page. Dashboard is OCHA's monthly overview, posted for Jul and Aug 2025 on 4 Sep and 14 Oct 2025.

cva_delivered_usd.note: 26 partners delivered US$27.9M to 904,000 people in nine provinces. By modality: paper vouchers 67%, mobile money 19%, e-vouchers 14%. By shock: cyclones $12M, conflict $9M, drought $4.5M.

mpc_delivered_usd.note: The overview does not split MPC from sectoral.

sectoral_cva_delivered_usd.note: The overview does not split MPC from sectoral.

fsps_note: No named FSP found. OCHA overview shows 19% of 2025 transfers by mobile money; WFP CSP revision 4 (31 Dec 2025) plans mobile-money transfers to 189,736 safety-net households without naming a provider.
